svg.title: ARA-290 in people: the six published trials
svg.desc: ARA-290 in people: the six published trials. Sarcoidosis pilot, 2012, 22 people, vs placebo: Symptom score improved. Sarcoidosis, 2013, 38 people, vs placebo: Symptoms improved. Type 2 diabetes, 2015, 49 people, vs placebo: Symptom score improved. Healthy adults (mood), 2015, 36 people, vs placebo: No mood effect. Sarcoidosis phase 2b, 2017, 64 people, vs placebo: Goal met in 1 of 3 groups. Diabetic eye swelling, 2020, 9 people, uncontrolled: No vision benefit.
